info.title: OCTO API
info.description:
OCTO (Open Connection for Tours & Activities) API — compliant with https://docs.octo.travel.

All requests require:
- `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header
- `Octo-Capabilities` header (comma-separated list, may be empty; supported values: `pricing`)
- `Content-Type: application/json` for POST, PATCH, DELETE requests

Two surfaces are documented here:
- `/octo/*` — the supplier's own OCTO endpoints, authenticated with an OCTO API key.
- `/partner-api/*` — the cross-tenant Partner API. Identical request and response shapes, authenticated with the partner's reseller API key. Resellers integrating against the Partner API should use only this prefix.

BearerAuth.description: OCTO API key issued per reseller. Pass in the Authorization header as `Bearer <token>`.

OctoCapabilities.name: Octo-Capabilities
OctoCapabilities.description: Comma-separated list of OCTO capabilities to activate (e.g. `pricing`). Pass an empty string to request no extras.

errorMessage.example: The Product ID was invalid or missing.

shortDescription.example: Premium tour operator based in Hawaii

unitPricing.description: Present when `pricing` capability is active and pricingPer=UNIT

tags.description: Cross-tenant Partner API — OCTO-shaped endpoints under /partner-api, authenticated with the partner reseller API key

get.description: Returns the OCTO supplier object for this tenant, including contact details and base endpoint URL. Includes `shortDescription` and `media` when the `content` capability is requested.

Returns all active tour products assigned to the authenticated reseller. Includes content fields (`title`, `description`, `media`, `locations`) when the `content` capability is requested, and pricing fields (`pricingPer`, `pricingFrom`, `defaultCurrency`) when the `pricing` capability is requested.
Returns a single product by its ID. The product must be assigned to the authenticated reseller.

example.errorMessage: The Product ID was invalid or missing.

post.description: Returns day-by-day availability for a product within a date range. Use this to build a calendar view. Includes `pricingFrom` and `unitPricingFrom` per date entry when the `pricing` capability is active.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (used when `pricing` capability is active)

units.description: Unit quantities for aggregate pricing calculation

400.description: Bad request — missing or invalid parameters

post.description:
Returns slot-level availability for a product. Can be queried either by date range (`localDateStart` + `localDateEnd`) or by specific availability IDs (`availabilityIds`). These two modes are mutually exclusive.

Each slot in the response carries `id` which should be passed as `availabilityId` when creating a booking.

availabilityIds.description: Fetch specific slots by ID. Mutually exclusive with localDateStart/localDateEnd.

get.description:
Returns bookings for the authenticated reseller. At least one filter (`resellerReference` or `supplierReference`) is required.

- `resellerReference` — the reseller's own booking reference stored in the contact payload
- `supplierReference` — the OCTO supplier reference in the format `OCTO-000001`

parameters.name: resellerReference
parameters.description: Filter by the reseller's booking reference

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: ISO 4217 currency code for pricing fields (when `pricing` capability active)

post.description:
Creates a new booking in `ON_HOLD` status. Seats are held until the booking is confirmed or the hold expires.

**Idempotency:** If a booking with the supplied `uuid` already exists it is returned unchanged — safe to retry.

**Hold expiration:** Defaults to 30 minutes. Override with `expirationMinutes`.

uuid.description: Client-generated UUID acting as an idempotency key. Auto-generated if omitted, and must be a valid RFC 4122 UUID when supplied. Repeating a request with the same uuid returns the original booking without reserving inventory again; reusing it for a booking with different product, availability or unit details returns 409 BOOKING_UUID_CONFLICT.

availabilityId.description: Slot ID from the availability check response

unitId.description: Rate/unit ID from the product catalog

200.description: Booking created (ON_HOLD) or existing booking returned (idempotent)

400.description: Validation error (invalid product, option, availability, or unit IDs, or a malformed uuid)

409.description: Conflict — the supplied uuid is already in use for a different booking (BOOKING_UUID_CONFLICT)

get.description: Returns the current state of a booking by its UUID.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: ISO 4217 currency code for pricing fields

example.errorMessage: The booking UUID was not found.

patch.description:
Updates an `ON_HOLD` or `CONFIRMED` booking.

**ON_HOLD bookings** — all fields are editable: `unitItems`, `availabilityId` (reschedule), `expirationMinutes`, `notes`, `contact`.

**CONFIRMED bookings** — `notes`, `contact`, and `resellerReference` are always editable. Structural changes (`unitItems`, `availabilityId`) are allowed only outside the cancellation cutoff window; rescheduling across calendar years is prohibited.

Cancelled or expired bookings cannot be updated.

unitItems.description: Replace the full guest list (ON_HOLD or CONFIRMED within cutoff window)

availabilityId.description: Reschedule to a new slot (ON_HOLD or CONFIRMED within cutoff window)

409.description: Conflict — booking already cancelled or expired

post.description:
Confirms an `ON_HOLD` booking. The booking is created in the internal system and a voucher QR code is attached to the response.

**Required fields:** `contact.firstName`, `contact.lastName`, `contact.emailAddress`.

**Idempotent:** If the booking is already `CONFIRMED` the current state is returned without modification.

Returns `409 BOOKING_EXPIRED` if the hold has expired.

resellerReference.description: Reseller's booking reference stored on the tour booking record

unitItems.description: Optional — update unit items at confirm time

400.description: Missing required contact fields or invalid unit IDs

post.description: Extends the expiration time of an `ON_HOLD` booking. The booking must not have already expired.

expirationMinutes.description: Additional minutes to add to the hold

200.description: Updated booking with new expiry time

post.description:
Cancels a booking. Both `ON_HOLD` and `CONFIRMED` bookings can be cancelled provided the cancellation cutoff window has not been passed.

Returns `409 BOOKING_ALREADY_CANCELLED` if the booking is already cancelled, and `409 CANCELLATION_NOT_ALLOWED` if the cutoff window has passed.

409.description: Already cancelled or cancellation not allowed (past cutoff)

get.description: Returns all webhooks registered for the authenticated reseller.

post.description: Registers a new webhook URL to receive OCTO event notifications.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint to receive webhook payloads

retries.description: Number of delivery retries on failure (default: 3)

get.description: Returns the details of a specific webhook by its ID.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a webhook by its ID.

post.description: Sends a test ping to the specified webhook URL to verify connectivity.
